method.season_ppg: season cumulative points / games played (GW1-3) - the cum_pts-leader signal that won 7 holdout rounds
method.recent_form: points per 90 over the season to date
method.recent_form_caveat: only 3 GWs played in 26/27 and no per-GW 26/27 splits exist in cache; the season window and the recent window coincide, so the 0.30 form term is near-degenerate and adds almost no separation this week. data/backtest/history.json is 2025/26 and was NOT used as form.
method.monte_carlo: 50,000 draws/player. Compound model: p(60+ mins) from mins/game x availability; goals/assists ~ Poisson on season per-90 rates (0.6 actual + 0.4 xG/xA) scaled by bisection so the simulated mean equals the player's SEASON ppg (season-anchored, not fixture-anchored); clean sheet / goals-conceded by FDR; bonus from season bps rate conditioned on returns.
method.floor_weighting_disclosure: Floor (p10) and ceiling (p90) are REPORTED as descriptive distribution context but are deliberately EXCLUDED from cap_score. CLAUDE.md states floor/matchup/form-3/form-5/table/venue were all tested across 7 holdout rounds and none beat cum_pts on unseen data, with an explicit 'DO NOT add new captain signals' lock. A floor-weighted EV ranking is therefore not the locked protocol and was not used to rank.
